subject: Re: Kickoff: Betum Tool for the Artemis Workshop (Dakar, June 1-5)
body:
Status + one metric risk we should settle now.

All four profiles run end-to-end as of yesterday (alpha milestone hit two weeks late, but hit). Baseline AP@50 on Coffee & Cashew: YOLO26 fine-tuned leads at 0.71, OWL-ViT zero-shot gets 0.52, SAM 3 prompt-to-box lands 0.63, and the DiffusionDet track trails at 0.48.

The risk: SAM 3's segmentation-to-bounding-box conversion inflates AP@50 on the dense cashew clusters - masks merge touching nuts, and the merged boxes still clear the 0.5 IoU bar. Tereza checked: at AP@75 the SAM 3 number collapses to 0.31 while YOLO26 holds 0.55. If we only report AP@50, the workshop's one-metric story quietly rewards the merge artifact.

Proposal: keep AP@50 as THE metric per the design, but the toolkit prints a per-team AP@75 diagnostic footnote. Students learn why the numbers diverge, which is honestly the best lesson in the whole workshp.

Chiara
